name: Severity cell
title: Components/Data grid/Severity cell
description: Carry the shared severity language into a dense row.
purpose: Carry the shared severity language into a dense row.
usage: This adapter renders SeverityBadge and accepts the same compact option.

css.value:
background var(--motion-fast),
    box-shadow var(--motion-fast),
    transform var(--motion-fast)

linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bg-surface) 60%, transparent),
    transparent
  )

1px solid
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--tag-fg) var(--badge-border-strength), var(--color-bg-surface))
